v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dixit Dóminus * Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis. ‡
text.en: The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand. ‡

text.la: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
text.en: Great are the works of the Lord, * sought out according to all his wills.

text.la: Qui timet Dóminum, * in mandátis eius cupit nimis.
text.en: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord; * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments. ‡

text.la: Sit nomen Dómini * benedíctum in sǽcula.
text.en: Blessed be the name of the Lord * from henceforth now and for ever.

text.la: Deus autem noster * in cælo: ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, fecit.
text.en: But our God is in heaven, * he hath done all things whatsoever he would.

text.la: Fratres: Hortámur vos, ne in vácuum grátiam Dei recipiátis. Ait enim: Témpore accépto exaudívi te, et in die salútis adiúvi te.
text.en: Brothers, we exhort you, that you receive not the grace of God in vain. For he saith: In an accepted time have I heard thee; and in the day of salvation have I helped thee.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Ecce nunc tempus * acceptábile, ecce nunc dies salútis: in his ergo diébus exhibeámus nosmetípsos sicut Dei minístros in multa patiéntia, in ieiúniis, in vigíliis, et in caritáte non ficta.
text.en: Behold, now is the accepted time * behold, now is the day of salvation; in these days therefore let us approve ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in fastings, in watchings, and in love unfeigned.

text.la: Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam ánnua quadragesimáli observatióne puríficas: præsta famíliæ tuæ; ut, quod a te obtinére abstinéndo nítitur, hoc bonis opéribus exsequátur.
text.en: O God, Who dost every year purge thy Church by the Fast of Forty Days, grant unto this thy family, that what things soever they strive to obtain at thy hand by abstaining from meats, they may ever turn to profit by good works.
